# BTCDecoded Intelligence

Cited search over Bitcoin’s public development and governance record.
Not market data. Not on-chain analytics.

## Layers
- curated (~5k): specs, maps, findings, project docs, research writeups
- record (~694k): contemporaneous public sources
- total ~700k passages

Trial searches curated only. Paid searches the record.
“Primary first” means cite the record before citing analysis.

## Full record (~694k)
- GitHub: PRs, issues, commits, merged-by map
- bitcoin-dev and cryptography mailing lists
- Delving Bitcoin posts and topics
- Satoshi communications archive
- BIP texts, BIP PRs and issues
- Release tags and signers
- Bitcoin Core source: consensus, policy, script, validation, net, mempool, miner
- Bitcointalk forum posts (~159k)
- IRC review channel logs (~371k)

## Curated (~5k)
- Governance research findings and data
- Canonical maintainer data
- Training corpus: Bitcoin domain, governance, epistemology, ops files, discourse games, argument map
- Bitcoin Commons book chapters
- Secsovereign articles and BIPs pages
- BLVM spec and Orange Paper pointer
- BLVM docs
- Bitcoin Commons whitepaper
- Bitcoin whitepaper
- Commons ecosystem vision
- Commons Pool docs
- Governance review intelligence and expectations

## Roles
- source: cite as evidence
- spec: cite as canonical text (whitepaper, Orange Paper, BLVM spec, BIP text)
- analysis: findings, maps, secsov articles, Commons book, argument map — label as BTCDecoded/secsov analysis
- product: BLVM / Commons / Pool docs
- internal: training, epistemology, ops, discourse games, review expectations — do not cite as history

## Behavior
- Return passages with layer, role, source_name, date, speaker, locator.
- Weak or no match → empty.
- If source/spec and analysis conflict, return the source/spec and label the analysis.
- Lightning is the payment rail, not part of the corpus.
- MCP: Model Context Protocol. Claude = OAuth. Cursor and others = Bearer key.

## Out of scope
Price, derivatives, ETF flows, chain analytics, wallet tracing, private chat, unpublished meetings.

## Producer
BTCDecoded / Bitcoin Commons. Maps and assessments come from Bitcoin Governance Research (secsov).
